observations: Photo 0: Silver Dell laptop open, screen shows Windows installation progress. Keyboard is silver, trackpad is centered. Dell logo visible below screen. Stickers on lower right: Intel Core i5 and Windows 10. Watermark: 'COMPUNET COMPUTER NIGERIA POSTED ON JIJI'.
Photo 1: Back of the same silver Dell laptop, covered in clear plastic wrap. Dell logo centered. Cables and power adapter on table. Watermark same as photo 0.
Photo 2: Same laptop, screen shows Windows installation progress, similar to photo 0. Keyboard and trackpad visible. Same stickers and watermark. A bottle of water and phone on the right.

All photos show the same laptop from different angles. No visible damage to body or keyboard. Screen appears to be working, showing installation UI. No touchscreen interaction shown. No model number visible on any photo.

claims.claim: American used very clean dell inspirion touchscreen 6th gen core i7 1tb 16gb ram keyboard light
claims.evidence: The brand 'Dell' is visible in photos 0, 1, and 2. The model 'Inspiron' is not visible in any photo. The screen shows Windows installation, not the OS or specs. No visible evidence of touchscreen, 6th gen Core i7, 1TB storage, 16GB RAM, or keyboard backlight. The 'very clean' claim is subjective and not verifiable from photos alone.

risks.risk: The laptop may not have a touchscreen, as no touch interaction is shown and no touchscreen indicator is visible.
risks.proof: A video showing touch input on the screen or a photo of the screen bezel with a 'touchscreen' label.

risks.risk: The processor may not be a 6th gen Core i7; the screen shows an Intel sticker but it is labeled 'Core i5' in photo 0 and 2.
risks.proof: A photo of the system information screen or BIOS showing the exact CPU model.

risks.risk: The storage may not be 1TB; no disk information is visible.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the Windows Disk Management or system info showing storage capacity.

risks.risk: The RAM may not be 16GB; no system info visible.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information showing installed RAM.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not have backlight; no photo shows it lit.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the keyboard with backlight turned on in a dark environment.

risks.risk: The laptop may be damaged or have hidden defects not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing full operation, including boot, shutdown, and all ports working.

proof_requests: Screenshot of system information showing exact CPU model, RAM, and storage.
Photo or video of keyboard backlight turned on.
Video of full boot and shutdown cycle with all ports tested.
Photo of the laptop's model label (usually on the bottom or inside the lid).
response.reason: The laptop is identifiable as a Dell, but the model, processor, storage, RAM, and touchscreen claims are unverified. Without proof of these specs, the item cannot be priced accurately. The photos show a working screen and no visible damage, but critical specifications are missing.
